title: Environment procedural primitive
description: Compiled procedural geometry as stored: walls, racks, floor slabs and other primitives.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the environment and type.

name.description: Display name. May be empty: readers then show a numbered fallback.

position.description: Position in the environment frame, metres.

rotation.description: Orientation as a quaternion. Writers are expected to keep it unit length; the schema cannot say so.

primitive_type.description: Kind of geometry, for example box, wall or rack.

template_key.description: Procedural template the primitive was compiled from.

size.description: Extents along the world axes, metres.

locked.description: Whether the editor refuses to move it.

fixed_base.description: Whether physics treats it as fixed.

color.description: A colour name or hex string, or a list of channel values.

material.description: A material name or a material description.

attach_to.description: The frame the primitive hangs off. Its rules stay with the platform.

attach_offset.description: Offset from that frame: position and rotation.
